enableAutomation.Name: Full automation
enableAutomation.Hint: Friend-or-foe prompt for areas that allow choosing targets. Use the preset button in this section to set up Midi QOL.

enableTurns.Name: BG3 turn flow
enableTurns.Hint: Consecutive allies share one turn; movement locked off-turn and budgeted on-turn.

enableEncounters.Name: Encounters and stealth
enableEncounters.Hint: Preset enemy groups that start combat when they spot or hurt a player.

lockGmMovement.Name: Lock GM movement too
lockGmMovement.Hint: If on, the GM is also blocked from moving tokens outside their turn.

defaultEncounterRadius.Name: Default encounter radius (ft)
defaultEncounterRadius.Hint: Detection distance proposed when marking an encounter.

obscuredDarkness.Name: Obscured darkness threshold
obscuredDarkness.Hint: Darkness level (0 to 1) at or above which a position counts as obscured for stealth.

dashNames.Name: Dash item names
dashNames.Hint: Comma-separated item names that double the movement budget for the turn when used.

Preset.Hint: Configure Midi QOL for fully automatic attacks, damage and saves with public dice.
Preset.Title: BG3 automation preset
Preset.Confirm:
This overwrites Midi QOL's workflow settings so attacks, damage and saves resolve with no prompts, all dice public, templates auto-target everyone inside, and reaction prompts (Shield, Uncanny Dodge, opportunity attacks) are on with a 30 second timeout. It also turns off dnd5e's own initiative grouping.

You can tweak any setting afterwards. Apply?

Targets.Title: Who does it affect?
Targets.Hint: This spell lets you spare your allies. Who should the area hurt?
